title: Seedling light trial
question: Does blue light change seedling height?
sampling_plan: Randomly sample eligible pots from one tray.
randomization_plan: Randomize pots to light before measurements begin.
calibration_plan: Verify the light meter against a reference before each collection day.
measurement_validity: Measure a marked stem with a calibrated ruler.
analysis_commitment: Estimate the mean difference and a confidence interval.
